What should I do if the tracking never updates?
If your tracking never updates, please don’t worry—there can be delays, especially for US shipments and during sale periods.
You should:
Allow 7–10 business days for International Express Shipping, plus up to 5 extra business days to dispatch during sales.
For US orders, wait until the parcel lands in the US, when tracking becomes available and you’ll receive an updated tracking email.
Keep an eye on your shipping confirmation email, where tracking is provided once the order has been shipped.
